## Scope

Describe the precise public change.

## Record classification

- [ ] Every added research record is `PUBLIC` and `PUBLISHED`.
- [ ] No supporter-only, private, or Vault material is included.

## Verification

- [ ] Inputs, provenance, parameters, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Reproduction instructions were run.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_records.py` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private paths, or restricted source material are present.

## Research language

- [ ] Claims are bounded to what the evidence establishes.
- [ ] Experimental, provisional, reproduced, and verified states are not conflated.
